responsibility: Provides StableMIR’s representation and inspection layer for MIR by combining the core data model for function bodies and control-flow (body.rs), the monomorphized item interface that resolves instantiated functions and statics to MIR bodies and related codegen-facing queries (mono.rs), and the immutable visitor/walking framework for traversing bodies and nested MIR constructs (visit.rs). Together these files define how MIR is represented, accessed for specialized items, and systematically explored.
